mapper.select: SELECT file_id, tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, file_name, file_path, object_key, bucket_name, storage_provider, file_size, mime_type, content_type, file_usage_type, uploaded_by, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_common_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT file_id, tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, file_name, file_path, object_key, bucket_name, storage_provider, file_size, mime_type, content_type, file_usage_type, uploaded_by, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_common_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT file_id, tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, file_name, file_path, object_key, bucket_name, storage_provider, file_size, mime_type, content_type, file_usage_type, uploaded_by, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_common_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(UPPER(owner_type), '') NOT IN ('APPROVAL', 'APPROVAL_COMMENT')

SELECT file_id, tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, file_name, file_path, object_key, bucket_name, storage_provider, file_size, mime_type, content_type, file_usage_type, uploaded_by, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_common_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO tb_common_file ( tenant_id, owner_type, owner_id, file_name, file_path, object_key, bucket_name, storage_provider, file_size, mime_type, checksum_sha256, content_type, file_usage_type, uploaded_by, deleted_yn, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{objectKey}, #{bucketName}, #{storageProvider}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{checksumSha256}, #{contentType}, COALESCE(#{fileUsageType}, 'ATTACHMENT'), #{uploadedBy}, #{deletedYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING file_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_common_file SET file_name = #{fileName}, file_path = #{filePath}, mime_type = #{mimeType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
